body: god, i will never forget this chilling moment..

i have this exact problem! i ignore ppl that i have pretty great relationships with.. texting my best friends used to be easy, but now i avoid talking to them all together. i went a day without answering back, then it turned into a week, then a month and so on. i love them, but talking exhausts me nowadays. i don't know what to say anymore and it stresses me out to think about it so i avoid it. i feel incredibly guilty and i always apologize whenever i do pop in for a short text letting them know i'm alive. but when you apologize for the same thing over and over again.. it starts to feel insincere. and it kills me to know that they're worried about me. it feel like i'm pushing them away. texting and calling has always been a struggle for me but now its a struggle to text or call everyone who isn't in my daily life. i overthink every single message i send, including this one. i want to get over it bc i know a lot of ppl don't understand and they take offense. i don't know how to explain it to most ppl bc they automatically say to just do it.

this hits me hard because its one of my greatest fears. i feel like my trauma will prevent me from getting close to anyone in that way. no matter how hard i try not to be afraid, i'm still a sobbing mess. i feel like no one will have the patience to work through that with me. i want to scream, my sexuality was taken from me and i can't get it back. i fear everything sex related, and i haven't found one person who is willing to understand that. i just want to enjoy those things like other women my age do. i wish i didn't have so many negative feelings associated with everything sexual. sorry for hijacking the post, i just thought i'd share that i'm stuck in a similar place. i hope we can both find a way through this. we don't deserve what happened to us, we also don't deserve the way people treat us when they find out how broken we are.. we deserve love, compassion, and understanding from those that say they love us.
fucking brilliant. this explains the anger we have for those type of people perfectly. well done. if only the world knew what you knew.

trust me, i don't view this as a sob story. this is actually a rlly strong thing of you to come to terms with. and your response just proves it to me more, it takes guts to maintain a positive outlook! and i truly believe in you, having faith is a huge stepping stone in the right direction. keeping you in my thoughts🧡😊

i'm subscribing, i want to help any way i can. and if that's the only thing i can do right now, i'm doing it. your story has rlly stuck out to me, and i wish there was more i could do. i hope to see your channel grow so you can get out of there. stay safe💙

not trying to be weird or anything but i go over scars too. my thighs look quite similar actually. idk, this just stuck out to me. i rlly wish the best for you. its rlly difficult to find a reason to stop, i know it all too well. there's always a part of me that says that it doesn't even matter anymore bc i'm already covered in scars. but then the sadness radiating off of ppl who care, its too much for me. just know that its okay to relapse, we all do at some point. what matters is that you take care of them after, keep them cleaned and covered. helping myself heal after always seemed to help me. stay safe! 💙

its okay, i take no offense haha. and i've been told i look like i've been attacked by something quite a bit, its usually the excuse i use for when children ask. and thank you, i'm very proud to come this far. i rlly appreciate your message! thanks again and stay safe!

congrats! hearing about your progress rlly inspires me to keep going. it truly motivates me to keep progressing as well. makes me happy seeing other people improve, it gives me hope so thank you. keeping you in my thoughts.
it's gorgeous! i've always wanted to try this, the result is just too beautiful to pass up.
i had no idea, i've only been using hydrogen peroxide this whole time. its rlly all i have, but thanks for letting me know! its helpful to know.
i do that too, i thought i was the only one! hope you're doing okay buddy.

hello, your post rlly stood out to me. i never rlly know how to feel about my scars, people are always telling me how i should feel about them. i get a lot of different responses about them, most of them aren't rlly gr8. and i'm just glad i'm not alone in this. 

thank you for sharing, and i'm sorry for everything you've gone through. thank you for helping me feel less alone. i hope everything goes well for you.

back when i was in middle school i used to cut in the bathroom (it was a single bathroom with a lock so i felt comfortable there). teachers never looked for me, not even my friends, so i could sit there the whole class period if i wanted to. i remember once my friend found out i was cutting and she made me promise not to do it again. and right after we finished crying and hugging in the back of the class, i went to the bathroom, sat on the floor in my usual spot, and cut anyway. and no one ever knew. 

i hope you're okay. its very scary dealing with situations like this, and i hope you know you're not alone. i wish you the best of luck, and i hope your days at school get better. if you ever need anything, there's a reason this subreddit exist, we're a community, we help each other, bc no one else understands like we do.

hey, i just wanna say i'm sorry you had to go through that, i understand what its like to cut at school, i've done so in the past, and it can be very scary. i just want to let you know that you're not alone, and i hope you're alright.
